## 1. A complete common-clock criterion

Consider a finite connected undirected single-flip graph. For each marked spin i,
let the attempt a_i(A)>0 be the same in both directions of its edge and let

    r_A(s->t)=a_i(A)/(1+exp(beta_A[E_A(t)-E_A(s)])).

The column generator includes exactly those positive edges and its negative
column sum. For c(A)>0,

    Q_A=c(A)Q_0

if and only if

    a_i(A)=c(A)a_i(0) for every i,
    beta_A E_A(s)=beta_0 E_0(s)+constant(A) for every s.

Proof: on any edge,r_A(s->t)+r_A(t->s)=a_i(A). Thus equality of generators
forces equality of the attempt ratios. Dividing forward by reverse rates gives
exp(-beta_A Delta E_A); equality forces beta_A Delta E_A=beta_0 Delta E_0.
